angularDiameterSource: Limb-darkened angular diameter 0.71 +/- 0.02 mas from VEGA on the CHARA array (Bonnefoy et al. 2018, section 2.3), the source of the radius.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 source 3732539683617410816: parallax 56.8577 +/- 0.1224 mas (RUWE 0.99), inverted to 17.5878 pc with no zero-point correction.
radiusSource: Radius 1.35 +/- 0.04 solar radii measured with the CHARA interferometer: a limb-darkened angular diameter of 0.71 +/- 0.02 mas at the Hipparcos parallax (Bonnefoy et al. 2018, A&A 618, A63; arXiv:1807.00657, section 2.3): 939,195 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 6200 K from their fit to the star's spectral energy distribution (Appendix A), the grid point closest to the spectroscopic solution of D'Orazi et al. (2017, A&A 598, A19). GM from the 1.2 solar masses they assume for the star in their spot model, times the JPL solar GM; the total mass of the orbit placed here is 1.20 solar masses (Bowler et al. 2020). presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is measured on the sky.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Bonnefoy et al. (2018), Appendix A, https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.00657
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/gj-504.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.257, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 504 (pscomppars): spectral type G0 V, from Kuzuhara et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...774...11K/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 504 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.28 dex, from Kuzuhara et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...774...11K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 504 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.332, from Kuzuhara et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...774...11K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 504 (pscomppars): age 0.16 Gyr, from Kuzuhara et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...774...11K/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 504 (pscomppars): rotation period 3.33 d, from D'Orazi et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...598A..19D/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 504 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 5.47 km/s, from Swastik et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..114S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius. The star's disc is not resolved; its color is Gaia's spectrum of it.
